## `urn:pm:schema:common`

Common definitions · visibility **public** · max class **C2**

| Definition | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `public_id` | string | Opaque public ID: type prefix + 26 Crockford base32 chars of 128 random bits. |
| `internal_uuid` | string | Internal UUIDv7. Internal contracts only. |
| `timestamp` | string | RFC 3339 UTC instant, millisecond precision, Z suffix. |
| `date` | string | Floating calendar date (no timezone). |
| `tz` | string | IANA timezone name. |
| `locale` | string | BCP 47 language tag. |
| `local_datetime` | object |  |
| `decimal` | string | Decimal as string; no binary floats. |
| `money` | object |  |
| `trace_id` | string | W3C trace-id used as correlation ID. |
| `request_id` | string | pattern `^req_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$` |
| `actor_type` | string enum: `human`, `ai`, `automation`, `integration`, `agent`, `system` |  |
| `actor` | object |  |
| `exec_state` | string enum: `queued`, `running`, `waiting`, `paused`, `succeeded`, `partial`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `skipped` |  |
| `terminal_reason` | string enum: `error`, `timed_out`, `limit_exceeded`, `policy_rejected`, `user_cancelled`, `emergency_stop`, `superseded`, `deduplicated` |  |
| `waiting_reason` | string enum: `approval`, `input`, `rate_limit`, `delay`, `external_confirmation`, `reconciliation_required`, `authorization_changed`, `dependency_unavailable` |  |
| `risk_class` | string enum: `R0`, `R1`, `R2`, `R3`, `R4` |  |
| `data_class` | string enum: `C0`, `C1`, `C2`, `C3`, `C4` |  |
| `cost_basis` | string enum: `measured`, `estimated`, `reported` |  |
| `record_ref` | object |  |
| `approval_ref` | object |  |
